# corename of the .info of every core in rootfs/packages.txt (libretro-core-info, the
# <core>_libretro.info files that rootfs/configure.sh copies to /usr/share/lume/libretro-info).
# RetroArch keeps the options of a core in config/<corename>/<corename>.opt, so the folders of
# factory/retroarch/config must be one of these names (game-experience-tuning D3).
# No .info file is available offline (they come with the libretro-core-info package of the
# image), so the names are copied here, checked on 2026-11-19 against
# https://github.com/libretro/libretro-core-info (master). A new core in packages.txt fails
# test_corename_fixture_covers_every_installed_core until its line is added here.
fceumm = "FCEUmm"
nestopia = "Nestopia"
gambatte = "Gambatte"
gpsp = "gpSP"
snes9x2005_plus = "Snes9x 2005 Plus"
genesis_plus_gx = "Genesis Plus GX"
picodrive = "PicoDrive"
fbneo = "FinalBurn Neo"
fbalpha2012_cps1 = "FB Alpha 2012 CPS-1"
fbalpha2012_cps2 = "FB Alpha 2012 CPS-2"
fbalpha2012_neogeo = "FB Alpha 2012 Neo Geo"
pcsx_rearmed = "PCSX-ReARMed"
mednafen_pce_fast = "Beetle PCE Fast"
fbalpha2012 = "FB Alpha 2012"
mame2003_plus = "MAME 2003-Plus"
mame2000 = "MAME 2000 (0.37b5)"
# The _lume builds (game-experience-tuning 11.1, lume_tool.cores_lume): the info file of the
# upstream core with " (Lume)" added to the corename (" (Lume, Cyclone)" for the armv7 builds
# with the Cyclone and DrZ80 assembly CPU cores); a test checks every line against the line of
# the upstream core above.
fceumm_lume = "FCEUmm (Lume)"
